
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhennann/p/19134406" title="发布于 2025-10-11 10:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">VonaJS AOP编程：全局中间件全攻略</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1462384/202510/1462384-20251011100529965-2146584436.png" alt="VonaJS AOP编程：全局中间件全攻略" class="desc_img">
        在VonaJS框架中，AOP编程包括三方面：控制器切面、内部切面和外部切面。控制器切面包括五能力：Middleware、Guard、Interceptor、Pipe、Filter。其中，Middleware又分为：局部中间件、全局中间件和系统中间件。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>在VonaJS框架中，AOP编程包括三方面：<code>控制器切面</code>、<code>内部切面</code>和<code>外部切面</code>。<code>控制器切面</code>包括五能力：<code>Middleware</code>、<code>Guard</code>、<code>Interceptor</code>、<code>Pipe</code>、<code>Filter</code>。</p>
<p>其中，<code>Middleware</code>又分为：<code>局部中间件</code>、<code>全局中间件</code>和<code>系统中间件</code>。其时序图如下所示：</p>
<p><img alt="aspect-controller" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1462384/202510/1462384-20251010102231200-529316275.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>由图可知，<code>系统中间件</code>在路由匹配之前执行，<code>局部中间件</code>和<code>全局中间件</code>在路由匹配之后执行。</p>
<p>为了简化起见，这里仅介绍<code>全局中间件</code>的用法，<code>局部中间件</code>和<code>系统中间件</code>的用法，请参见官方文档。</p>
<h2 id="创建中间件">创建中间件</h2>
<p>比如，在模块 demo-student 中创建一个 全局中间件: <code>logger</code></p>
<h3 id="1-cli命令">1. Cli命令</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">$ vona :create:bean middleware logger --module=demo-student --boilerplate=cli/middlewareGlobal/boilerplate
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-菜单命令">2. 菜单命令</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">右键菜单 - [模块路径]: `Vona Aspect/Middleware Global`
</code></pre>
<h2 id="中间件定义">中间件定义</h2>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">export interface IMiddlewareOptionsLogger extends IDecoratorMiddlewareOptionsGlobal {}

@Middleware&lt;IMiddlewareOptionsLogger&gt;({ global: true })
export class MiddlewareLogger extends BeanBase implements IMiddlewareExecute {
  async execute(_options: IMiddlewareOptionsLogger, next: Next) {
    const timeBegin = Date.now();
    const res = await next();
    const timeEnd = Date.now();
    console.log('time: ', timeEnd - timeBegin);
    return res;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>IMiddlewareOptionsLogger</code>: 定义中间件参数</li>
<li><code>execute</code>: 输出执行时长</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="使用中间件">使用中间件</h2>
<p>与局部中间件不同，系统会自动加载全局中间件，并使其生效</p>
<h2 id="中间件参数">中间件参数</h2>
<p>可以为中间件定义参数，通过参数更灵活的配置中间件逻辑</p>
<p>比如，为 logger 中间件定义<code>prefix</code>参数，用于控制输出格式</p>
<h3 id="1-定义参数类型">1. 定义参数类型</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">export interface IMiddlewareOptionsLogger extends IDecoratorMiddlewareOptionsGlobal {
+ prefix: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-提供参数缺省值">2. 提供参数缺省值</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">@Middleware&lt;IMiddlewareOptionsLogger&gt;({
  global: true,
+ prefix: 'time',
})
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-使用参数">3. 使用参数</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">export interface IMiddlewareOptionsLogger extends IDecoratorMiddlewareOptionsGlobal {
  prefix: string;
}

@Middleware&lt;IMiddlewareOptionsLogger&gt;({
  global: true,
  prefix: 'time',
})
class MiddlewareLogger {
  async execute(options: IMiddlewareOptionsLogger, next: Next) {
    const timeBegin = Date.now();
    const res = await next();
    const timeEnd = Date.now();
-   console.log('time: ', timeEnd - timeBegin);
+   console.log(`${options.prefix}: `, timeEnd - timeBegin);
    return res;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-使用时指定参数">4. 使用时指定参数</h3>
<p>可以针对某个 API 单独指定全局中间件的参数</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">+ import { Aspect } from 'vona-module-a-aspect';

class ControllerStudent {
  @Web.get()
+ @Aspect.middlewareGlobal('demo-student:logger', { prefix: 'elapsed' })
  async findMany() {}
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>在使用中间件时直接提供参数值即可</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="5-app-config配置">5. App config配置</h3>
<p>可以在 App config 中配置中间件参数</p>
<p><code>src/backend/config/config/config.ts</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// onions
config.onions = {
  middleware: {
    'demo-student:logger': {
      prefix: 'elapsed',
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<h3 id="6-参数优先级">6. 参数优先级</h3>
<p><code>使用时指定参数</code> &gt; <code>App config配置</code> &gt; <code>参数缺省值</code></p>
<h2 id="中间件顺序">中间件顺序</h2>
<p>由于全局中间件是默认加载并生效的，所以，VonaJS 提供了两个参数，用于控制中间件的加载顺序</p>
<h3 id="1-dependencies">1. dependencies</h3>
<p>比如，系统有一个内置全局中间件<code>a-core:gate</code>，我们希望加载顺序如下：<code>a-core:gate</code> &gt; <code>Current</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">@Middleware({
  global: true,
+ dependencies: 'a-core:gate',
  prefix: 'time',
})
class MiddlewareLogger {}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-dependents">2. dependents</h3>
<p><code>dependents</code>的顺序刚好与<code>dependencies</code>相反，我们希望加载顺序如下：<code>Current</code> &gt; <code>a-core:gate</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">@Middleware({
  global: true,
+ dependents: 'a-core:gate',
  prefix: 'time',
})
class MiddlewareLogger {}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="中间件启用禁用">中间件启用/禁用</h2>
<p>可以针对某些 API 控制全局中间件的<code>启用/禁用</code></p>
<h3 id="1-enable">1. Enable</h3>
<ul>
<li>针对某个 API 禁用</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class ControllerStudent {
  @Web.get()
+ @Aspect.middlewareGlobal('demo-student:logger', { enable: false })
  async findMany() {}
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>针对所有 API 禁用</li>
</ul>
<p><code>src/backend/config/config/config.ts</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">// onions
config.onions = {
  middleware: {
    'demo-student:logger': {
+     enable: false,
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-meta">2. Meta</h3>
<p>可以让全局中间件在指定的运行环境生效</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>名称</th>
<th>类型</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>flavor</td>
<td>string|string[]</td>
<td>参见: <a href="https://vona.js.org/zh/guide/techniques/mode-flavor/introduction.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">运行环境与Flavor</a></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>mode</td>
<td>string|string[]</td>
<td>参见: <a href="https://vona.js.org/zh/guide/techniques/mode-flavor/introduction.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">运行环境与Flavor</a></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>instanceName</td>
<td>string|string[]</td>
<td>参见: <a href="https://vona.js.org/zh/guide/techniques/instance/introduction.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">多实例/多租户</a></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>host</td>
<td>string|string[]</td>
<td>主机名</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<ul>
<li>举例</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-diff">@Middleware({
  global: true,
+ meta: {
+   flavor: 'normal',
+   mode: 'dev',
+   instanceName: '',
+   host: 'localhost:7102',
+ },
})
class MiddlewareLogger {}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-matchignore">3. match/ignore</h3>
<p>可以针对指定的 API 启用/禁用全局中间件</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>名称</th>
<th>类型</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>match</td>
<td>string|regexp|(string|regexp)[]</td>
<td>针对哪些API启用</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>ignore</td>
<td>string|regexp|(string|regexp)[]</td>
<td>针对哪些API禁用</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="查看当前生效的全局中间件清单">查看当前生效的全局中间件清单</h2>
<p>可以直接在 Controller action 中输出当前生效的全局中间件清单</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class ControllerStudent {
  @Web.get()
  async findMany() {
+   this.bean.onion.middleware.inspect();
  }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>this.bean.onion</code>: 取得全局 Service 实例 <code>onion</code></li>
<li><code>.middleware</code>: 取得与中间件相关的 Service 实例</li>
<li><code>.inspect</code>: 输出当前生效的全局中间件清单</li>
</ul>
<p>当访问<code>findMany</code> API 时，会自动在控制台输出当前生效的全局中间件清单，效果如下：</p>
<p><img alt="middleware-1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1462384/202510/1462384-20251011100512156-426926247.png" class="lazyload"></p>
